title: Benford's Law: Why the Number 1 Leads the World
question: Why do so many real-world numbers start with the digit 1, and what does that reveal about how quantities grow?
summary: Across populations, river lengths and financial data, about 30% of numbers start with 1. This exploration traces Benford's law to logarithms, scale invariance and multiplicative growth, and looks at how it catches fraud.
